paragraphs: Chisda, or Rav Chisda: Avdimi bar Chisda; Avin bar Chisda; Shmuel bar Chisda. [The source contains malformed markup here.] [Glosses: Chisda. (a) Niddah 49b: Rav Chasa said, “Our great teacher”—Rabbi—“said this.” I think it should read Chisda, since he regularly speaks thus; so too in the new Talmud editions. (b) Gittin 62a, near the end: Rav Huna and Rav Yehudah were sitting. I think it should read “and Rav Chisda”; so too in the new Talmud editions.]
